en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a rural village scene with a large half-timbered inn labeled as Voigt's Gasthof in the foreground, a tree-lined open space with children and adults standing and posing, and a church with a tall, tiered spire and clock tower in the background. The top left contains printed German text identifying the location as Grünlichtenberg near Waldheim and naming the guesthouse.
